# Subgroup error breakdown by Income_Bracket (generated by scripts/fairness_analysis.py)

Model: `models:/credit-risk-classifier@champion` (version 1, run `82268557`, data v1), decision threshold 0.1326.

FNR = share of actual defaulters the model misses (bank's credit-loss risk). FPR = share of good customers wrongly flagged (customer-harm risk: extra review, lower limits).
